ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Shim Database Patching Activity
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects installation of new shim databases that try to patch sections of known processes for potential process injection or persistence.

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\AppCompatFlags\\\\Custom\\\\.*") AND (registry_path = RGX("\\\\csrss\\\.exe$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\dllhost\\\.exe$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\explorer\\\.exe$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\RuntimeBroker\\\.exe$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\services\\\.exe$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\sihost\\\.exe$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\svchost\\\.exe$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\taskhostw\\\.exe$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\winlogon\\\.exe$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\WmiPrvSe\\\.exe$")))
